title: Dimension of the orthogonal complement of a nondegenerate bilinear form
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $V$ a finite-dimensional $k$-vector space [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace], and $B:V\times V\to k$ a bilinear form (linear in each variable). Assume that $B$ is nondegenerate: both $B(x,y)=0$ for all $y\in V$ implies $x=0$, and $B(x,y)=0$ for all $x\in V$ implies $y=0$. For a linear subspace $W\subseteq V$, define $W^\perp=\{v\in V:B(w,v)=0\text{ for every }w\in W\}$. Then, with dimension [def-weil-vector-space-dimension], $\dim_k W^\perp=\dim_k V-\dim_k W$.
